Posterior predictions

Source: R/predict.R
predict.bpk_fit.Rd

Without regimen, returns individual predictions at the observed times of the fitted subjects. With regimen, simulates concentrations for that regimen: type = "population" draws new subjects from the estimated between-subject distribution, type = "typical" uses the typical subject. Predictions are computed in R from posterior draws with the closed-form solutions; no refit is needed.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bpk_fit'
predict(
  object,
  regimen = NULL,
  times = NULL,
  type = c("population", "typical"),
  covariates = list(),
  ndraws = 1000,
  probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95),
  residual = FALSE,
  seed = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A bpk_fit.

regimen

Optional dosing regimen from dose_regimen().

times

Times for regimen predictions (default: 100 points over the regimen plus one dosing interval).

type

"population" or "typical" (used with regimen).

covariates

Named list of covariate values for regimen predictions; unspecified covariates are set to the reference value of each term (categorical terms to their non-reference state, i.e. indicator 0).

ndraws

Number of posterior draws used.

probs

Quantiles to report.

residual

Logical; add residual error (prediction intervals for observations rather than for the concentration).

seed

Random seed.

...

Unused.

Value

A data frame of predictions with quantiles.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("nlmixr2data", quietly = TRUE)) {
d <- nlmixr2data::theo_sd
mod <- pk_model("1cmt", route = "oral", iiv = c("CL", "V", "KA"))
fit <- bpk_fit(mod, d, chains = 2, iter = 1000, seed = 1)
predict(fit, regimen = dose_regimen(320, ii = 12, n = 3), ndraws = 200)
}
